subject: SE technical demo + security Q&A - Acme Retail
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-retail.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@acme-retail.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request: SE technical demo + security Q&A

Hi Marissa,

We'd like to schedule a technical demo of Redwood with our engineering and security teams next week. Goal is to walk through inference architecture, deployment options (VPC/on-prem), and discuss security controls (SOC2, data handling, KMS).

Stakeholders:
- Alex Chen, Engineering (will own evaluation)
- Priya Natarajan, InfoSec
- Procurement (procurement@acme-retail.com)

Preferred times (PT):
- Tue 5/5 afternoon (1-4pm)
- Thu 5/7 morning (9-11am)

Can you loop in your SE and provide an agenda and any pre-read? Also if you need any network access or sample data ahead of time, let us know.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Senior Manager, Platform Engineering
Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@acme-retail.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: SE technical demo + security Q&A

Hi Alex - thanks for the intro. Happy to run this. Looping in Jordan (SE) and our security contact Kimberly.

Jordan - can you run the demo + security Q&A? Below is what I suggest: 45-60 minute session (30m demo, 15-30m security + procurement Q&A). I’ve also put a Calendly link if we want to let the group pick a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-se/45min

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 5/5 1:30pm-2:15pm
- Thu 5/7 9:30am-10:15am
- Fri 5/8 10:00am-10:45am

Priya / procurement - do any of these work? If you need SOC2/attestations or a draft SOW ahead of time, I can attach a template and Jordan can share the technical agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + request: SE technical demo + security Q&A

Hi Alex / Marissa - thanks for looping me in. Draft agenda attached (Acme-Technical-Agenda.pdf). I’ll plan for a 45-minute session:

- 0-5m: Intros + goals
- 5-35m: Architecture walkthrough (serving runtime, VPC/private options, model routing, caching/kv, quantization tradeoffs)
- 35-45m: Integration considerations (API, SDKs, auth/KMS)
- 45-60m: Security & procurement Q&A (SOC2, logging, data retention, auditability)

Couple of asks to make the demo useful:
- If you can share a high-level diagram of where inference will be invoked from (edge services, batch jobs, etc.), we can tailor the demo.
- Will the demo need network access to any internal resources? We usually keep everything cloud accessible, but if you want to demo private connectivity we can discuss VPN/VPC peering options.

I attached the agenda.

- Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-retail.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: SE technical demo + security Q&A

Thanks - agenda looks good. A couple of pre-demo asks from InfoSec:
- Can you provide SOC2 Type II report or attestations (or link to them)?
- Details on data handling: what data is sent to Redwood-hosted endpoints vs kept in-customer VPC, and options to use customer-managed KMS/HSM.
- Any penetration test reports or third-party security scans.

Procurement: please confirm whether you need a draft SOW or commercial terms before we schedule.

Thanks,
Priya
Lead Information Security Engineer
Acme Retail
